next.reason: 1985: violation of the exponentiation rules 'always terminates the arithmetic operation and always causes a size error condition'. 2023: the size error condition exists 'if the rules for evaluation of exponentiation are violated' (§2023:14.7.5 GR1); §2023:8.8.1.2 GR6: 'the EC-SIZE-EXPONENTIATION exception condition is set to exist and the size error condition is raised'; with the phrase 'the values of all of the resultant data items remain unchanged from the values they had at the start of the execution of the arithmetic statement' (§2023:14.7.5, catalog L2.1), and §2023:14.7.7 GR4 'If the size error condition is raised during the initial evaluation, none of the resultant data items are changed'. Which values violate (VI.6.2.3 GR5) and the no-phrase EC handling (L3.1, vs 1985 GR3) are other records.
